stories.summary: Park a scope-gate miss as a plan defect instead of spending the rework budget
stories.description: A branch outside its declared files cannot be fixed by the agent when the plan failed to declare the path; park it with a reason that says so.

stories.summary: Warn at ingest when a brief names a production path the scope omits
stories.description: Advisory check beside the existing scope_headroom warning: the brief mentions a production path that is not in files.
Defense in depth: add the operator key carrier to the agent secret denylist so a dispatched agent never inherits it.
